_note: Townspeople. 'label' is what they do, shown with their name. 'sprite' is their picture in art/sprites.json; a second frame named like 'npc_innkeeper_2' makes them animate. Until a role has its own sprite, 'standIn' is drawn instead. Their dialog-screen portrait is the role's entry in art/portraits.json, and the backdrop behind them depends on the tile they stand on ('backdrops', from art/backdrops.json). 'disposition' gives the odds of each mood for a new person (Friendly, Neutral, Wary, Hostile); a role can have its own. walkSpeed is in tiles per second; talkReach is how close (in tiles, feet to feet) you must be to talk to someone; pauses and walks are in game updates (60 a second), picked at random between the two numbers.
